name: Website Development
heroSubtitle: Fast, conversion-focused business websites, corporate portals, portfolios, and custom landing pages built for reliability.
shortDescription: Business websites, portfolios, landing pages, corporate websites and custom websites engineered for speed, clarity, and conversion.
fullDescription: We architect and build responsive, search-ready websites tailored to your brand identity and business objectives. Whether launching a high-converting landing page, an executive corporate presence, or a custom multi-page web platform, every build prioritizes clean semantics, fast load performance, and effortless maintainability.

benefits.title: Credible Digital First Impression
benefits.description: Structured typography, clean layouts, and fast page loads build immediate trust with prospective clients.

benefits.title: Search-Engine Ready Structure
benefits.description: Semantic HTML, Open Graph social cards, clean metadata, and structured headings help your pages index cleanly.

benefits.title: Effortless Content Updates
benefits.description: Organized CMS content files allow your team to update copy, links, and media without developer bottlenecks.

features.title: Responsive Multi-Device Layouts
features.description: Carefully tested across desktop monitors, laptops, tablets, iOS, and Android viewports.

features.title: Modern Component Architecture
features.description: Built on React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS for clean long-term maintainability.

features.title: Dark & Light Theme Support
features.description: Optional dual-theme UI systems tuned for legibility in every lighting environment.

features.title: Contact & Lead Routing
features.description: Validated inquiry forms, WhatsApp quick links, and direct email handoff.

processSteps.title: Site Architecture & Content Mapping
processSteps.description: We organize your pages, navigation hierarchy, and core messaging around visitor actions.

processSteps.title: UI Design & Visual Prototyping
processSteps.description: We craft a cohesive visual language with clean spacing, typography, and responsive breakpoints.

processSteps.title: Engineering & CMS Integration
processSteps.description: We build clean, fast frontend components wired to structured content files and SEO tags.

processSteps.title: Launch Verification & Handover
processSteps.description: We test forms, links, speed, and mobile usability before deploying to your domain.

faqs.question: Can I update text and images on my website after launch?
faqs.answer: Yes. We structure projects for clean CMS management such as Pages CMS so your team can edit copy, images, and links directly.

faqs.question: Are TOP TECH websites mobile-friendly and SEO-ready?
faqs.answer: Every website is built mobile-first with semantic HTML, page-specific titles and meta descriptions, and clean Open Graph tags.

faqs.question: Do you handle custom domains and hosting setup?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can deploy to GitHub Pages, Vercel, Netlify, or your preferred hosting provider and assist with DNS setup.

idealFor: Businesses, founders, consultants, and organizations establishing or upgrading their digital presence.
